faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: How is the Visibility Score calculated?
faq.a1: We ask AI platforms dozens of questions your customers typically ask and measure how often — and at which position — they name your brand. The 0–100 score combines branded, category and comparison prompts.
faq.a2: Perplexity — always; ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude — on the full scan. The list keeps growing.
faq.q3: How long does a scan take?
faq.a3: The free scan takes about a minute. A full scan of 100 prompts across 4 platforms takes up to 15 minutes; we email you the report link.
faq.a4: AI answers vary: the same question can produce different answers. We run repeated passes and average them, so the score reflects a stable picture rather than a single reply.
faq.a5: We walk through your report, show where you lose customers, and propose a plan: sources, content, mentions. We execute it for you and track the score's growth.
faq.a6: The scan is free. Improving your visibility is scoped on the call — it depends on your category and competition.
